18-01-opti-1: A sharp spine. A thick green pad. Where are we?
18-01-opti-2: White sand, hot sun. Rain soaks away fast.
18-01-opti-3: A cactus? Out here, in rainy Florida?
18-01-opti-4: Not far away, cypress trees stand in water.
18-01-opti-5: A summer storm rolls in. Every plant gets the same rain.
18-01-opti-6: This leaf lets the rain roll right off.
18-01-opti-7: A desert and a rainforest. Same roots, stems, and leaves…
18-01-opti-8: …but each one is built for a different home.
18-01-opti-9: These pleats can stretch. What could that be for?
18-01-opti-10: Let's find out how plants fit their homes.
18-01-warm: A brand-new film! Today our camera visits wild plants. Look closely at the first one before we explain anything.
18-01-lesson: Today you're the crew's botanist, a scientist who studies plants. Watch a cactus drink a storm, test leaves in hot sun, and walk across Florida.
18-01-check: Three quick questions. It's not graded. It's just for you, so give each one your best try.
18-01-assign: Your turn to show what you know. Name the trait first. Then say how it helps the plant in its home.
18-01-words: Adaptation. Trait. Advantage. Environment. Reproduce. Root system.
how-specimen-plant: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the plant, then tap three things you notice.
how-wall-plant: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing layer: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the plant shows.
how-detective-plant: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict where it grows, and watch its home appear.
